msgs: 62 laps, 35 passes on track and 2 virtual safety cars

a: Red Bull, from P1 on the grid

asks.q: was it actually good or are you being nice
a: 35 passes on track, not counting the ones in the pit lane

asks.q: i know nothing about f1, start there
a: ok so 22 cars, lined up roughly in qualifying order, less any grid penalties
in a dry race everyone has to use two different tyre types, so everyone stops at least once, and you spend about 24 seconds in the pit lane when you do
the whole sport is basically deciding WHEN to lose that time

msgs: 13 places changed hands before they even finished lap 1

asks.q: why is the start always so mad
a: cold tyres, cold brakes, full fuel tank and everybody going for the same gap
it's the only moment of the race where the whole field is that close

asks.q: does the start decide the race
a: track position is everything on most circuits, you lose places on lap 1 and you can spend a long time stuck behind someone slower
